Hiya! I'm trying to sew a skirt, but my thread keeps on breaking!

I've run into this problem before occasionally, but now it's so bad that I can't even sew one stitch. I've sewn skirts before and this is the first time that it has been this bad. I've used this same thread before and never had it snap this often.

Does anyone with more knowhow about sewing know what the cause could be? Could it be something about the settings on my machine, and what should I look for? Could it be that I'm using the wrong needle for the fabric? Picture of fabric Close up

Any help or suggestions would be greatly appreciated! I really wanted to work with this fabric and make the skirt, but I can't even get started and it's really frustrating.

Thanks in advance!

Could be a few things. Tension is the most common issue. However, looking at the fabric you are using, I think your needle is too small. When your needle is too small, it can create weird friction and snap the thread. I would try using a larger needle and also a larger stitch. Try on some test strips and make the stitches parallel so you can easily compare. Post back here with results.
Ah, thanks! That seems to have done the job. :) Now at least I can finish the first part of the skirt.
